prompt.content: What is the name of the stag that stands atop Valhalla and chews on the branches of the tree Læraðr?

output:
The stag that stands atop Valhalla and chews on the branches of the tree Læraðr is called **Gullinbursti**.

In Norse mythology, Gullinbursti is the golden-horned horse of Freyr, and it is said to be the best horse
